meanings.gloss: his, its (with masculine/neuter nouns in the dative)

sentences.text: Er will mit seinem Vater sprechen.
sentences.en: He wants to talk to his father.
Mark is coming in his car.
He has to help his father.

sentences.text: Von seinem Geld weiß ich nichts.
sentences.en: I know nothing about his money.

sentences.text: In seinem Leben hat er viel gesehen.
sentences.en: He has seen a lot in his life.

sentences.text: Dan ist mit seinem Vater in London.
sentences.en: Dan is in London with his father.

sentences.text: Er hat das Buch von seinem Vater.
sentences.en: He got the book from his father.
